correctness.rationale: Walsh characters diagonalize adjacency A with eigenspaces indexed by Hamming weight j=0,...,d. The visible/bright subspace decomposes into ranges of three trap-evaluation vectors in each Walsh shell. Endpoint shells j=0,d each have rank 1. For 1≤j≤d−1, any antipodal trap pair imposes a parity-proportional column relation and rank exactly 2, while absence of any antipodal pair forces rank 3 via a nonzero coordinate-swap contradiction in F_2^d; the binary difference vectors cannot all exhibit the same parity behavior otherwise. Total rank is 2+2(d−1)=2d or 2+3(d−1)=3d−1. With strictly positive loss strengths, a bright eigenvector cannot have a nondecaying zero-loss component, so the long-time surviving subspace equals the Hermitian-dark eigenspace; the projection formula gives absorption from arbitrary initial rho, including maximal mixture. Antipodal-pair triples: (2^(d−1))(2^d−2) over C(2^d,3), ratio 3/(2^d−1). An independent exact rational Walsh rank enumeration tested every anchored triple for d=2,3,4,5, confirming ranks on 3,21,105,465 configurations respectively; this is corroborative, not an infinite proof.
residual_risks: Requires 3 distinct strictly positive sinks, unweighted d-dimensional Boolean hypercube and Hermitian adjacency hopping.
No absorption-time distribution, unequal hopping weights or >3 sink classification.

originality.rationale: Bernasconi–Godsil–Severini 2008 proves known antipodal perfect state transfer on cubelike graphs. Novo et al 2014 proves general Krylov/invariant-subspace transport formulas and explicitly obtains the one-site hypercube bright dimension d+1 (Eqs. 44–47). Other 2013–2020 one-site/single detection papers address related but differently constrained transport. None of the inspected full primary texts states the exact rank 2d versus 3d−1 for all triples of positive sinks or the condition that any pair is antipodal. Generic observability rank machinery could imply the result after work; that residual is genuine. Novelty is the all-three-site placement classification, not Walsh diagonalization, single site or antipodal transfer.

value.rationale: Three simultaneously monitored sites are the smallest arrangement that can distinguish interior-shell rank three from rank two by antipodal incidence. The complete geometric and rate-independent bright-space classification for every cube dimension yields sharp absorption fractions (including full vs three-quarters on the three-cube) and frequency of exceptional configurations. This is a natural physically motivated invariant, not an arbitrary tiny finite-rank computation.
